result: The stationary path is a second class factory, not a gap. 004F0BE0 resolves its type by text through 00851CB0, which takes the row from the StationaryClass Lua global and wraps it in a 3Ch-byte class, entirely separate from 00964790's VehicleClass chain. Ormoc Bay's units reach it a different way: they are LandFort rows whose Stationary scene property makes 004F0FB0 allocate through 00748C40, a 1ACh prop. Its observer pair is 00CFF678 and 00CFF65C, and the units host now uses it.
question: Read 004F0BE0 whole and whatever the Stationary class's own instantiate does instead of the descriptor chain, and note the DummyTargetVehicle gap.
answer: 004F0BE0 looks up Type at 004F0BFE, requires the property to be type 4 or 2, takes its text with 008F0DF0, calls 00851CB0 with it, calls that class's vtable+4h to allocate and then 004F04C0 for the shared setup. 00851CB0 checks a cache through 00851B40 and otherwise fetches the globals, takes StationaryClass by name, takes the row by the type's own text, and builds a 3Ch-byte class. That is why this installation's 220 StationaryClass rows carry no Type literal: the field would have no reader. USN22's units do not come that way. They are LandFort scene rows whose type token names a StationaryTypes symbol, so they reach 004F0FB0, which tests the scene property Stationary and takes the instance from 00748C40 instead of the descriptor's vtable+28h. 00748C40 is operator new(1ACh) then 00748A40, which stores 00CFF678 at this+0, 00CFF65C at this+10h and 00CFF654 at this+24h. Which of those is the observer pair is checked against a class that already has a row rather than assumed: 00745940, the LandFort constructor, stores 00CFF3F8 at this+0, 00CFF3E0 at this+10h and 00CFF3B4 at this+310h, and LandFort's row is {00747000, 00CFF3F8, 00CFF3E0} with 00CFF3B4 as its tick vtable. So observed is the vptr at this and callback the one at this+10h. The prop is 1ACh bytes with no slot at 310h, so it carries no tick vtable and takes no motion dispatch.
coverage: complete for 004F0BE0, 00851CB0, the 004F0FB0 stationary arm and the prop's observer pair; the rest of the prop's construction and 00851B40's cache are contracts.

The type id a StationaryTypes token resolves to may collide with an unrelated VehicleClass row of the same number, because the host indexes VehicleClass by that id and the two enums are different id spaces. The StationaryClass test is by text and is immune, but a false positive on the VehicleClass side would take the descriptor arm first.

DummyTargetVehicle is the one Type literal with no observer row and no motion-dispatch row. It is the same shape of gap and would raise the same throw. Left open deliberately: its leaf constructor was not read, and inventing its pair from the pattern is what the control in 00745940 exists to avoid.
